mapper.select: /* LeaveFlowMapper.selectNextReqId */ SELECT CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), FNC_CMM_SEQ_NEXTVAL(#{cmpnyCd}, 'ATTD_REQ_ID')) FROM DUAL
/* LeaveFlowMapper.selectNextLeaveId */ SELECT CONCAT('LV', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), FNC_CMM_SEQ_NEXTVAL(#{cmpnyCd}, 'LEAVE_USE_ID')) FROM DUAL

/* LeaveFlowMapper.selectLeaveTypeInfo */ SELECT A.SYSTEM_YN AS systemYn , A.APRV_USE_YN AS aprvUseYn , A.USE_UNIT_TYPE AS useUnitType , A.LEAVE_TYPE AS leaveType , A.MAX_APLY_DAYS AS maxAplyDays , A.AVAIL_TERM_TYPE AS availTermType FROM TB_LEAVE_TYPE_MGMT A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.LEAVE_CD = #{leaveCd} LIMIT 1
/* LeaveFlowMapper.getAdvisoryLock */ SELECT GET_LOCK(#{lockKey}, #{timeoutSec})
/* LeaveFlowMapper.releaseAdvisoryLock */ SELECT RELEASE_LOCK(#{lockKey})
/* LeaveFlowMapper.selectPolicyAprvUseYn */ SELECT P.APRV_USE_YN FROM TB_LEAVE_POLICY P WHERE P.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY P.POLICY_SEQ DESC LIMIT 1

/* LeaveFlowMapper.selectLeaveReq */ /* PRAFTA-025: 연차사용('05')/연차수정('06') 모두 결재 흐름을 공유하므로 둘 다 조회한다. 06일 때 최종 승인 단계에서 TARGET_ID(대상 LEAVE_ID)와 새 값(start/end/days)으로 기존 사용기록을 in-place 갱신한다. */ SELECT A.REQ_ID AS reqId , A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , A.USER_CD AS userCd , A.REQ_STATUS AS reqStatus , A.REQ_TYPE AS reqType , A.TARGET_ID AS targetId , A.WORK_YMD AS workYmd , A.START_DATE AS startDate , A.START_TIME AS startTime , A.END_DATE AS endDate , A.END_TIME AS endTime , A.LEAVE_DAYS AS leaveDays FROM TB_USER_ATTD_REQ A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.REQ_ID = #{reqId} AND A.REQ_TYPE IN ('05', '06') AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' LIMIT 1

/* LeaveFlowMapper.selectLeaveUseDetailByReqId */ SELECT U.LEAVE_CD AS leaveCd , U.USE_UNIT_TYPE AS useUnitType , U.USER_CD AS userCd , U.SITE_CD AS siteCd , U.START_DATE AS startDate FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE U WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.REQ_ID = #{reqId} AND U.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY U.INSERT_DATE DESC LIMIT 1

/* LeaveFlowMapper.selectUserNodeSelfApproveYn */ SELECT N.SELF_ATTD_APPRV_YN FROM TB_USER U JOIN TB_SITE_NODE N ON N.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND N.SITE_CD = U.SITE_CD AND N.NODE_CD = U.NODE_CD WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND N.SELF_ATTD_APPRV_YN = 'Y' AND (N.MAIN_ADMIN_CD = U.USER_CD OR N.SUB_ADMIN_CD = U.USER_CD) LIMIT 1

/* LeaveFlowMapper.selectLeaveModifyTarget */ SELECT U.LEAVE_CD AS leaveCd , U.GRANT_ID AS grantId , U.USE_UNIT_TYPE AS useUnitType , U.LEAVE_DAYS AS leaveDays , U.SITE_CD AS siteCd , U.USER_CD AS userCd , U.START_DATE AS startDate , G.GRANT_DAYS AS grantDays , G.USED_DAYS AS usedDays FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE U LEFT JOIN TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT G ON G.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND G.GRANT_ID = U.GRANT_ID WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.LEAVE_ID = #{leaveId} AND U.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' LIMIT 1
